card.line: Zorah was a hilltop town in the foothills, given to the tribe of Dan, and it was the hometown of Manoah and his son Samson.

moments.title: Manoah of Zorah
moments.text: A man named Manoah lived in Zorah, and his wife had no children. The angel of the LORD told her she would have a son who would begin to deliver Israel from the Philistines.

moments.title: Danites send out spies
moments.text: The Danites had not yet come into an inheritance among the tribes, so they sent five men of valor from Zorah and Eshtaol to explore the land. The men came back and said the land was very good.

moments.title: Six hundred leave Zorah
moments.text: After the spies urged their brothers to go take the land, six hundred Danites left Zorah and Eshtaol armed with weapons of war. They camped at Kiriath-jearim in Judah.

moments.title: Samson is buried near Zorah
moments.text: After Samson died, his brothers and his father's family carried him back. They buried him between Zorah and Eshtaol in the tomb of his father Manoah.
